info.name: RMIS Restaurant POS ERP - API v1
info.description: Version-controlled Postman collection generated from the implemented Laravel API. Import RMIS-local.postman_environment.json, select it, then run Login with email/phone and password. Login resolves a single active tenant automatically. All protected requests send the returned X-Tenant-UUID and Bearer access_token.

request.description: Starts landlord registration and asynchronous tenant provisioning. Email or Tanzanian phone is required.
Poll until tenant provisioning reports a completed or failed status.

Authenticates centrally and automatically resolves a single active restaurant workspace. A successful response stores the tenant UUID, access token, and active branch UUID. If a tenant selection response is returned, copy its selected tenant UUID into the active environment and send Login again; the request includes it automatically.

Authenticates centrally, resolves a single active workspace automatically, ends its previous device session, and creates the replacement session. No tenant header is required for a single-workspace account.

request.description: Required permission: sales_channels.view.
Required permission: service_types.view.
Required permission: payment_methods.view.
Required permission: counters.view.
Required permission: counters.create. Creates all counters in one transaction. The request is rejected as a whole if any counter is invalid or duplicates an existing branch counter.
Required permission: counters.update.
Required permission: dining_areas.view.

Required permissions: dining_areas.create and dining_tables.create. Creates all submitted dining areas and nested tables in one transaction. The request is rejected as a whole if any row is invalid or duplicates an existing branch name.
Required permission: dining_areas.view. Returns the area, tables_count, and nested tables.
Required permission: dining_areas.update.
Required permission: dining_tables.view.
Required permission: dining_tables.create. Creates one table and assigns it to an existing dining area.
Required permission: dining_tables.view. Returns the table and its dining area.
Required permission: dining_tables.update.
A completed manual payment is required before a reservation is recorded.
Creates exactly one linked POS order. The reservation deposit is applied as items are added.
Opens one reconciliation for each active branch cash account that requires reconciliation.
Allowed reasons: cash_in, cash_out, or safe_drop. The selected drawer must be open.
Replaces all denomination lines and moves the drawer to closing, preventing further cash movements.
Server calculates expected cash, counted cash, and variance, then closes the drawer.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('base_url')) { throw new Error('Select the RMIS local environment before sending requests.'); }
if (tenantHeader && !pm.variables.replaceIn(tenantHeader).trim()) { throw new Error('Run Login successfully, or set tenant_uuid to a restaurant workspace UUID, before sending this request.'); }
